structured.answer: The page says there are two questions: where the money sits (deposit, קרן השתלמות, a securities account) and what it's invested in (like an S&P 500 index). So for me it's a חשבון ניירות ערך with an S&P 500 fund, or checking what my קרן השתלמות is in. But it doesn't tell me which is better or what it costs.

stuck.where: Long grid of cards from 'כסף שוטף וקצר' down to 'לילדים'
stuck.why: Too many similar cards with no numbers and no sign of which suits me; got bored and nearly left
Expected a starting point for investing, but it pointed to pension, השתלמות and קרן כספית, nothing about S&P
MSCI cards' text was cut off, and screen 5 repeated screen 4, so I wasn't sure I'd seen everything

findings.what: No numbers anywhere: no fees, no returns, so I can't tell which option is better, only what each one is
About 30 cards that look alike, with no clear pick for a young person with savings
'מאיפה להתחיל' doesn't mention investing in an index at all, though that's what most people come for
Lots of jargon in the card text (מק"מ, צמודה, בניהול אישי)
No first step: doesn't say where to open a securities account
Last screen repeats the one before it, and the MSCI cards are cut off between screens
